name: std::ranges::view_interface<D>::cbegin

declarations.code:
constexpr auto cbegin() const
    requires ranges::range<const D>;

intro:
The default implementation of cbegin() member function returns a constant beginning iterator of the range.

1) Let derived be a reference bound to static_cast<D&>(*this).

Equivalent to return ranges::cbegin(derived);.

2) Same as (1), except that derived is static_cast<const D&>(*this).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A constant beginning iterator of the range.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: All range adaptors and range factories in the standard library and std::ranges::subrange use the default implementation of cbegin.

summary: The default implementation of cbegin() member function returns a constant beginning iterator of the range.
